issues.section: 10.1 加上磁场 · Definition 10.1 衰变不对称度
issues.quote: 对整个正电子能谱平均，a = 1/3；能量最高的正电子 a 升至 1。
issues.problem: Positron-energy dependence of the asymmetry is reduced to two numbers. For counter design (thresholds, absorbers, degraders) the user needs a(ε) = (2ε−1)/(3−2ε) with ε = E/Emax (Emax = 52.8 MeV) and the fact that a < 0 for ε < 1/2.
issues.fix: Add the formula and a small plot of a(ε) and the Michel spectrum; state that an energy threshold raises the effective A0.

issues.section: 交互玩具模型 · TOY MODEL 近似
issues.quote: 我们的 Geant4 运行给出 A0 = 0.241 ± 0.009，因为正电子在铜中散射并损失能量，而且计数器是方形板而不是圆锥。
issues.problem: Energy loss by itself does not lower A0; absorbing low-energy positrons raises it. The drop comes from multiple scattering, the square-slab acceptance and the up-to-15 mm of Cu (≈1 X0) that a positron emitted along ±y must cross in this 30×30×6 mm target.
issues.fix: Reword to 'scattering in up to 15 mm of copper and the square acceptance'; optionally add a thin-sample variant so students see A0 rise.

issues.quote: λ 与零相容，因为磁场完全均匀。
issues.problem: It is never stated that Geant4/musrSim simulate only the instrument (beam, field, positron detection), not the sample's spin dynamics: there are no local fields, nuclear dipoles, Kubo–Toyabe or muonium. A condensed-matter user might think a simulated Cu target should show the real Cu relaxation.
issues.fix: Add a box: what the simulation can give a μSR user (stopping fractions, instrument A0, α, backgrounds), what it cannot give (the sample's relaxation function), and how to put a model polarisation function in by hand if needed.

issues.section: 动手实验 · 实验 10 / 复习要点
issues.quote: A(t) = (N_D − N_U)/(N_D + N_U) = A0 sin(ωt + φ)
issues.problem: Core μSR analysis practice is missing for the physics track: the balance parameter α in A = (N_D − αN_U)/(N_D + αN_U), t0 and t_good, forward/backward and LF/ZF geometries, pulsed (ISIS, ~10 MHz frequency limit from the pulse width) vs continuous (PSI) beams, pile-up, and how a simulated A0 or α feeds a musrfit fit.
issues.fix: Add an α step (shift one counter by 2 mm, fit α) and a short section that maps the course output to musrfit parameters.

issues.section: 10.2 让物理列表保持诚实 · Course-W10-a
issues.quote: 修正（一行，在创建列表后）：physicsList->RegisterPhysics(new G4SpinDecayPhysics());
issues.problem: musrSim.cc has no 'physicsList' variable: the list is created inline in 'runManager->SetUserInitialization(new FTFP_BERT(1,steeringFileName));' (checked in the musrsim-sms source). A non-C++ user cannot apply the 'one line' fix. I checked: G4SpinDecayPhysics has physics type 0, so RegisterPhysics does add it; the claim itself is right.
issues.fix: Give the exact patch: #include "G4SpinDecayPhysics.hh"; auto* pl = new FTFP_BERT(1, steeringFileName); pl->RegisterPhysics(new G4SpinDecayPhysics()); runManager->SetUserInitialization(pl); plus the expected /process/list output.

issues.problem: The only install route for the musrSim weeks is a CERN CVMFS view on centos7. Most users in mainland China and many university machines have neither. The page itself says musrSim was never built or run by the course, so every musrSim output is unverified.
issues.fix: Provide a tested Docker/Apptainer image (Geant4 10.7.2 + ROOT 6 + musrsim-sms with the spin fix), or a conda recipe, and replace the 'taken from source' outputs with real ones.

issues.section: 动手实验 · 实验 9：两个独立样本，再到批量生产 (production.sh)
issues.problem: 201.mac is never supplied or described. In musrsim-sms it is the run/ macro for the 2010 GPD instrument; it needs GPD_coil_primitive.table, runs '/control/execute vis.mac', and ends with '/run/beamOn 10', so 50 jobs give 500 events. production.sh does 'cd $(dirname $0)' and calls '../musrSim', so it only works if it is copied into build/run together with 201.mac, the field table and vis.mac. None of this is said.
issues.fix: Explain what 201.mac is (GPD high-pressure instrument), list the files to copy into build/run, and set beamOn in the sed (or use tf_musr.mac for the production exercise).

issues.section: 动手实验 · 用 Python 分析 t1 (analyse_t1.py)
issues.quote: popt, pcov = curve_fit(decay, centres, counts, p0=[counts.max(), 2.2, 0.0])
issues.problem: Unweighted least squares on Poisson counts, so the quoted ±0.0270 µs error is not a valid uncertainty (Week 10 does weight). Bins with few counts at large t are over-weighted.
issues.fix: Use sigma=np.sqrt(np.maximum(counts,1)), absolute_sigma=True, or a Poisson likelihood; print χ²/ndf as in Week 10.

issues.problem: Not explained. In musrPrimaryGeneratorAction.cc a negative max disables the decay-time window, so the line is a no-op; a μSR user might think it is a time cut.
issues.fix: Add a comment: 'min max τ; max<0 = no forced window'.
